::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1880s, 1890s?]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear [Miss Hutchins](people/person_739.qmd)

I am so sorry I did not send these before. They came at a very busy time, and I am sorry to say I put them into a drawer with some Christmas cards and forgot them till [Miss Cazenove](people/person_274.qmd) reminded me.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
